answer: We define a security vertex where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds impose a liquidity drain on illicit identity proliferation, effectively sequestering attacker capital within an isolated economic lagoon. By implementing subgame-perfect punishment matrices, we ensure that the cost of identity multiplication strictly exceeds the marginal rewards, transforming the network into a deflationary haven for honest actors. This mechanism enforces a negative expected utility for Sybil attacks, driving the system to a robust Nash equilibrium where unilateral deviation remains strictly sub-optimal.
